spanish: hiriendo pueblos en furor, golpe sin cesar, dominando en ira naciones, perseguido sin refrenar.

findings.issue: murddaph (noun) rendered as passive 'perseguido' (implying the subject is victim of persecution)
chasak (qal pf 3ms, the ruler 'has not restrained') rendered without preserving the 3ms agent or the unrestrained action of the ruler
bilti sarah smoothed to 'sin cesar' (grammatical smoothing, does not change core sense)

notes: passive voice and participant shift on final clause violate token morphology
